query: I dropped featuredimg.png in the repo root for the preventive-maintenance cluster article — turn the Confluence draft into a news post with all the inline images wired up.
expected_behavior: Runs the marketing-pages repo guard before writing anything
Confirms the slug with the user before uploading, since the slug drives both ImageKit folders and the featured-image name
Names each inline image after the section it illustrates, converts each to resized webp with to-webp.sh, and uploads to blog-posts/<slug>/
Chooses ::image-text for wrap-left/wrap-right Confluence layouts and ::fImg for centered or full-width images, writing a real alt description for each (WCAG)
Verifies uploaded names landed clean with no random suffix, spot-checks the ImageKit URLs, and removes the dropped-in featuredimg.png on cleanup
